name: building-blocks-media-primitives
title: Media Primitives
description: Predictable Tailwind media blocks for framed previews, avatar image slots, and image overlay captions.
useWhen: Predictable Tailwind media blocks for framed previews, avatar image slots, and image overlay captions.
avoidWhen: Avoid media primitives when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Media Primitives uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
